data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to execute initialization and disposal logic declaratively.
data.what_it_does: The package provides an Init widget that allows you to specify initialization, post-frame, dependency change, and disposal logic as parameters. This helps reduce boilerplate code usually found in StatefulWidget lifecycles like initState and dispose.
use_when: You want to trigger initialization or disposal logic without creating a full StatefulWidget.
You want to encapsulate initialization patterns in a reusable way across your widget tree.
avoid_when: You already manage your state and side effects inside a complex state management solution.
You require fine-grained imperative control over custom state objects.
strengths: Reduces boilerplate of creating StatefulWidgets just for lifecycle methods.
Makes initialization and disposal logic declarative and modular.
weaknesses: Limited to basic widget lifecycle hooks provided by the Init wrapper.
Not documented for complex state management needs.
data.minimal_example:
Init(
  onInit: () => print('Initializing...'),
  onDispose: () => print('Cleaning up...'),
  child: const Text('Hello!'),
)
